title: chore(pm-dispatch): effort by the shape of the work; group by mechanism and fold by default
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuXK7QdbYq9xzp28gTBPUHFW)_

Fixes #35283
Part of #35270

What stays open on the effort card after this PR: its three measurement runs (the card calls them sweeps) and the lines that wait on them — the L2 review level and whether the high-severity diff review can drop — plus the ADR-revision standing order, which changes only on the maintainer's own word, and one line of the checklist runner text that now disagrees with the new rule and is outside this PR's files (Acceptance notes).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: ruled
Ruling-ref: the maintainer's own words, each with its source and time. 「立卡修改skills」 and 「安全修复只有高风险的才需要 xhigh 吧」: seat 5's thread, dated 2026-11-19 by card #35270, which quotes them and was filed 2026-11-19 00:59Z; they carry the effort lines. 「按机制归组，每组做一次分析、出一个合并修复 PR, 同意，立卡修改skills」: seat 5's thread, dated 2026-11-19 by card #35283, which quotes it and was created 2026-11-19 01:45Z; it carries the grouping lines. 「C 收敛版」: seat 5's decision card, 2026-11-19 03:55Z, quoted in the body of card #35283; it carries the fold lines other than the p1 clause of `references/execution-duties.md` 27, which the last quotation here carries. 「同意」: this PR's project thread, 2026-11-19 22:20Z, transcribed as ruling record 7024443457 on card #35270, the maintainer's answer to the three questions the contract review escalated, put to the maintainer as three decisions with options A, B and C recommended in that order; it carries the high-severity effort lines as written, the red-line re-read kept at xhigh, and the last-and-batched rule for the later advisory groups. 「可以，由一张 p1 领头」: the option the maintainer chose on a decision card in this PR's project thread, 2026-11-20 00:36Z, to the question 「确认几张 p1 卡能不能合成一单来做」, transcribed with the card's full text as ruling record 7026582389 on card #35283; it carries the p1 clause of `references/execution-duties.md` 27, that a fold which holds a p1 is headed by a p1.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:产品用户无感;车队派活不再因为卡的类别(安全、专题子卡、高优先级)就用最贵的思考档,只有预计无人值守跑半小时以上的大活、以及高危安全修复的一次只读复核才用;安全修复按同一根因成组,一组一次分析、一个合并修复;同区能合并的普通卡默认合成一个合并请求。
- 为什么做:安全卡很多,逐张按最高档分析、修复、复核太贵;这两项是你在成本复盘后点名要写进车队规则的。
- 出错会怎样:只改规则文字,不改产品代码;某类活降档后质量下降,改回对应那一行即可直接撤回;安全修复仍留一次最高档的只读复核和逐条复现测试。
- 要你做什么:没有待你确认的事:三处写法你已在 11-19 22:20Z 答复「同意」,几张最高优先级的卡可以合成一单、由其中一张领头这一句你已在 11-20 00:36Z 选定,都已照此写入。

## What changes

Rule text only: eight skill files and the line ratchet's ceiling rows. Four commits: `3062b1b7` (effort, #35270), `7b4a981e` (grouping and folding, #35283), `9a41e512`, which rewords four lines in place after the contract review of `7b4a981e` (record 7016878162: its findings S1, S2 and S3 and its nit N3), and `5cb1c475`, which writes the maintainer's answer to the three questions that review escalated (`references/execution-duties.md` 125 and 131 and `references/lanes/security.md` 34, in place) and brings the ratchet row comments up to the wording at the head. The four lines of `9a41e512` are `SKILL.md` 320, `references/lanes/security.md` 20 and 25, and `references/execution-duties.md` 27; their rows below give the wording at the head.

Line numbers are those of this branch's head; paths in the tables are under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/`, except `checklist-test/SKILL.md`, which is under `.claude/skills/`. "Card body" means the line is worded from the card, which was filed on the maintainer's 「立卡修改skills」; where a longer quote carries the line, it is given verbatim.

### Effort (#35270)

| File and line | The rule now | The maintainer's words that carry it |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `references/execution-duties.md` 124 | `xhigh` only for a build expected to run unattended for over 30 minutes (usually XL), or a card type a measurement record shows gains on | card body, filed on 「立卡修改skills」 |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 125 | beyond that, only L2 review, four-axis analysis, ADR work, the red-line re-read and the diff review of a high-severity advisory fix are `xhigh`; both lines outrank the size line | card body, as narrowed below ("Lines left as they are"); the red-line re-read by the maintainer's 「同意」 (this PR's project thread, 2026-11-19 22:20Z), decision 二 below |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 126 | an epic child card and a p1 go by the card's own difficulty; a category never raises a level; `max` on a named or standing order, or to test the ceiling | card body, filed on 「立卡修改skills」 |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 127 | security is graded by consequence, not by label: only a high-severity advisory fix earns `xhigh` | 「安全修复只有高风险的才需要 xhigh 吧」 |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 128 | and not for the whole build: built at `high`, then one read-only subagent at `xhigh` does a short adversarial review of the diff; medium severity runs at `high` | 「安全修复只有高风险的才需要 xhigh 吧」; the split into build and review is the seat's answer on the card to 「目前的安全卡非常多，按照这个标准是不是很烧钱，有没有更好的方案」, which the maintainer accepted as written: 「同意」 (this PR's project thread, 2026-11-19 22:20Z), decision 一 below |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 129 | a `security`-labelled card that is no advisory fix (dependencies, UX, copy) goes by difficulty | same two quotes |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 130 | every security fix carries a regression test that reproduces the attack (red before, green after); fixes sharing one mechanism share one analysis | 「按机制归组，每组做一次分析、出一个合并修复 PR, 同意，立卡修改skills」 |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 131 | of the two re-reads a card thread hands to an isolated subagent, only the design re-read runs at `high` (was `xhigh`); the red-line re-read stays `xhigh` | card body for the design re-read; 「同意」 (this PR's project thread, 2026-11-19 22:20Z) to the option worded 「只降设计自查，红线自查保持最贵档」, decision 二 below |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 132 | no session changes effort mid-session; another level goes to an isolated subagent | card body, filed on 「立卡修改skills」 |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 133 | unsure ⇒ `high`, never `xhigh` on doubt (was: raise one level) | card body, filed on 「立卡修改skills」 |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 134 | read-only lookup and fetch helper subagents: floor `medium`; a single-shot lookup may use `low`; a long check chain never `low` | card body, filed on 「立卡修改skills」 |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 135 | effort values come from this repository's own same-card measurements, never carried over from an older model generation; re-measured when a tier changes generation, readings on a record card | card body, filed on 「立卡修改skills」 |
| `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 40 | a seat session never changes effort mid-session (line 39, sessions stay `high`, is unchanged) | card body, filed on 「立卡修改skills」 |
| `references/security-findings.md` 27 | the flat `xhigh` is gone: the security seat dispatches a public-repo fix per its charter, by group | 「安全修复只有高风险的才需要 xhigh 吧」 and 「按机制归组，每组做一次分析、出一个合并修复 PR, 同意，立卡修改skills」 |
| `SKILL.md` 320 (claim template, the `effort:` field only) | an `xhigh` value cites, on the same line, its duration reading, its measurement record, or the standing order that fixes the level (by id and time) | card body, filed on 「立卡修改skills」 |
| `checklist-test/SKILL.md` 107 | the adversarial re-review of a disputed verdict runs at `high`; `xhigh` only as `execution-duties.md` says | card body, filed on 「立卡修改skills」 |

**Answered by the maintainer — the security effort lines (127 to 130 above, the diff-review item of line 125, and `security-findings.md` 27).** The card calls them a seat proposal to confirm before landing. Their first basis is the maintainer's 「安全修复只有高风险的才需要 xhigh 吧」 and the 「同意」 inside 「按机制归组，每组做一次分析、出一个合并修复 PR, 同意，立卡修改skills」. They were then put to the maintainer as decision 一 below, and the answer was 「同意」 (this PR's project thread, 2026-11-19 22:20Z) to the lines as written. The security measurement run the card asks for is still owed on the effort card.

### Grouping and folding (#35283)

| File and line | The rule now | The maintainer's words that carry it |
|:---|:---|:---|

| `references/lanes/security.md` 23 | one lead advisory per group, a lone advisory is a group of one; one analysis on the lead, a one-line pointer on every other member | same quote |
| `references/lanes/security.md` 25 | the ledger row carries an opaque group tag, never a mechanism word; a member moves state only when the PR that carries its fix merges | same quote (card item 4) |
| `references/lanes/security.md` 30 | fixes are dispatched by group (two words added in place) | same quote |
| `references/lanes/security.md` 31 | one order, one branch, one PR, one L2 review per group; the five fold gates and the effort rule are read from `execution-duties.md`, not restated | same quote |
| `references/lanes/security.md` 32 | a group stays inside one owning package's release line and the normal PR size limits; a group too large splits into ordered PRs | same quote (card item 3) |
| `references/lanes/security.md` 33 | every advisory in a group carries its own regression test; the PR proves every member | same quote (card item 3) |
| `references/lanes/security.md` 34 | groups holding a high- or medium-severity advisory go first; the other groups go last, are dispatched only when none of the first kind is waiting, and are batched by owning package into one order and one PR, an exemption from fold gate ① | 「同意」 (this PR's project thread, 2026-11-19 22:20Z) to the option worded 「排在最后；没有高危、中危的组在等的时候再派，并按所属的产品包攒成一批一起修」, decision 三 below |
| `references/lanes/security.md` 43 | the publish-or-not list is laid out by group, members under their lead | same quote (card item 7) |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 25 | when all five fold gates pass, the cards fold by default (at most five) | 「C 收敛版」, chosen after 「其他 area 可以用类似的方案吗？」 and 「是否建议合并开发，技能是怎么约定的，是否需要优化」 |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 26 | gate ① also admits same-file text-only cards (`Clause-②: no`) | 「C 收敛版」 |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 27 | gate ②: members share the landing tier and the L2 tier; a fold that holds a p1 is headed by a p1 | 「C 收敛版」 for the tier clause; for the p1 clause, the option the maintainer chose on 2026-11-20 00:36Z, 「可以，由一张 p1 领头」 (ruling record 7026582389 on card #35283) |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 29 | gate ⑤: a p3 riding a same-file PR is exempt from gate ① | 「C 收敛版」 |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 30 | exit: a member whose premise fails, or whose open items are not cleared in one round, loses its commit and `Fixes` line and returns to the queue, never holding the group | 「C 收敛版」 |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 31 | the fold-or-serial answer is owed whenever a seat or an area holds two or more claimable cards with one mechanism or a shared hot file | 「C 收敛版」 |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 33 | triage's fold suggestion is spelled `Fold-with: #N` | 「C 收敛版」 |
| `references/area-lease.md` 47 | the claim must answer: same-area cards that pass the five gates go into one PR by default, otherwise serial | 「C 收敛版」 |
| `references/triage-duties.md` 78 | the triage audit comment may also carry a `Fold-with: #N` line | 「C 收敛版」 |

### Lines left as they are

- **The ADR-revision standing order** (`execution-duties.md` line 100, 「…ADR 修订常设令 `xhigh`,新裁决除外」) is unchanged. The effort card allows that change only with the maintainer's own word, and there is none. For the same reason the rewritten `xhigh` list (line 125) keeps ADR work at `xhigh`.
- **Four-axis analysis stays `xhigh`** (line 125). The card's item "four-axis analysis … run at `high`" is cut by the seat on its claim: ruling record 6999656302, the maintainer's 「1+2+4」, stands in the skill as 「决策线程 effort 恒 `xhigh`,`max` 仅维护者点名」. `references/decision-analysis.md` and `references/coordinator.md` are not edited.
- **L2 review stays `xhigh`** (line 125) and `references/lanes/l2-review.md` is not edited (card item 2). The card ties that line to its review measurement run, and no run was made for this PR.
- **The read-only diff review of a high-severity advisory fix is `xhigh`** (lines 125 and 128), for the same reason: the security measurement run that could lower it has not been made.
- **The p3-rides line** (`area-lease.md` line 46) is unchanged, as the grouping card says.
- **No `Same-mechanism:` marker** is introduced anywhere, as the grouping card says.
- **"Grouping and analysis at `high`"** (grouping card, item 6) needs no new line: the security seat does both in its own session, and `seat-lifecycle.md` line 39 already holds every seat session at `high`.

### Line ratchet rows moved (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`)

Counts measured with `wc -l` against `origin/main` at `97f34203` and this branch's head.

| File | Lines before | Lines after | Ceiling before | Ceiling after | Ruling of record |
|:---|---:|---:|---:|---:|:---|
| `references/execution-duties.md` | 184 | 195 | 189 | 195 | +9 from the effort card body (「立卡修改skills」, with 「安全修复只有高风险的才需要 xhigh 吧」), claim comment 7014658145; +2 from the grouping card body (「C 收敛版」), claim comment 7014764185. The 5 spare lines pay 5 of the 11; the row moves +6. The grouping card itself counted +1 here; this head takes +2 (see below the table). |
| `references/lanes/security.md` | 53 | 61 | 53 | 61 | +8, the grouping card body: 「按机制归组，每组做一次分析、出一个合并修复 PR, 同意，立卡修改skills」, claim comment 7014764185. |
| `references/triage-duties.md` | 108 | 109 | 108 | 109 | +1, the grouping card body (「C 收敛版」), claim comment 7014764185. The marker does not fit the existing audit-comment line: 117 bytes today, 132 with it, against the 120-byte cap. The grouping card itself counted +0 here (an edit beside the existing line). |
| `references/seat-lifecycle.md` | 98 | 99 | 99 | 99 | no row moved; the one spare line pays. |

Each raise is an ordinary ruled raise under ruling record 6184799323 (letter B): the card body that quotes the maintainer is the ruling of record, and the row lands at the file's count with headroom 0. `SKILL.md` (328), `security-findings.md` (65), `area-lease.md` (71) and `checklist-test/SKILL.md` (279) are edited in place and keep their rows. No existing line was re-wrapped or merged to make room.

Against the grouping card's own count: the card counts its fold items as one line of growth in `execution-duties.md` and words the triage marker as an edit beside the existing suggestion line, so +1 and +0. This head takes +2 and +1. The two extra lines are the 120-byte cap at work, not added rules: gate ①'s same-file arm does not fit the gate line (117 bytes), and the `Fold-with:` marker does not fit the audit-comment line (117 bytes, 132 with it). Each row still moves by no more than the measured delta of text the card orders.

### The three questions put to the maintainer, and the answer

The contract review of `7b4a981e` (record 7016878162, section ③) left three lines for the maintainer to answer before the merge. They were put to the maintainer on 2026-11-19 in this PR's project thread as three decisions, each with its options and a recommendation. The answer, verbatim and untranslated, is 「同意」 (2026-11-19 22:20Z), to the recommendation of options A, B and C in that order. It is transcribed, with the message it answered and each option as worded, as ruling record 7024443457 on card #35270, and for decision 三 also on card #35283.

| Decision | Options as put | Answer | Where it lands |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 一, the effort of a high-severity advisory fix | A: as written, a `high` build plus one `xhigh` read-only diff review. B: the whole fix at `xhigh`. C: hold these lines until the security measurement run | A | `references/execution-duties.md` 127 to 130, unchanged |
| 二, the red-line re-read | A: both re-reads at `high`. B: only the design re-read at `high`, the red-line re-read stays `xhigh` | B | `references/execution-duties.md` 131 reworded; 125 now names the red-line re-read |
| 三, advisory groups that hold no high- or medium-severity advisory | A: fixed only when riding a group that goes first. B: dispatched one by one after the others. C: last, only when no group of the first kind is waiting, batched by owning package | C | `references/lanes/security.md` 34 reworded |

Decision 三 as answered puts several groups that share no mechanism into one PR. Fold gate ① and line 31 of the lane file (one order, one branch, one PR per group) do not allow that, so line 34 states the batch as an exemption from gate ① on its face. The owning-package bound and the PR size limits (line 32) and the regression test per advisory (line 33) still apply to a batch. A low-severity advisory that shares a mechanism with a higher one is in that group by line 20 and goes first with it.

Decision 二 replaces what the effort card ordered for the red-line re-read (lowered with the design re-read) and agrees with the effort list the maintainer approved on 2026-11-12 (ruling record 6830795926).

The message that carried the recommendation also said that an epic child card and a p1 no longer get `xhigh` by category (line 126), against that same 2026-11-12 list, and asked the maintainer to say so in case of disagreement. The 「同意」 answered that message. Line 126 is unchanged.

The delta contract review of `5cb1c475` (record 7025214949, section ③) left one more clause for the maintainer: the p1 clause of fold gate ② (`references/execution-duties.md` 27; Acceptance notes). It was put to the maintainer on 2026-11-19 in this PR's project thread as a decision card with two options: keep the clause as written, so that several p1 cards may fold into one order headed by one of them, or go back to the card's wording, one p1 to a fold. The maintainer chose the first, 「可以，由一张 p1 领头」, on 2026-11-20 00:36Z. The card's full text is transcribed as ruling record 7026582389 on card #35283. No rule line changed on that answer, and the head is the same.

## Tests

All gates below ran at head `7b4a981e`, each exit code captured before any pipe. The fix commit `9a41e512` changes four lines in three skill files and no script: the 25 commands `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives from those three files were run again at `9a41e512`, 25 of 25 exit 0 (`--ran`: 25 run, 0 not measured), the line ratchet prints the same counts and ceilings as below, its self-test passes 164 cases, and the overlap check before that push reads clean against `origin/main` at `f981dce3` and PR #35610 (shares `SKILL.md`, merges cleanly). The four edited lines measure 118, 119 and 120 bytes against the 120-byte cap; the fourth is a claim-template line inside a code fence, which the cap exempts. The answer commit `5cb1c475` changes three rule lines in two skill files and comment lines of the ratchet script (no code line, no ceiling number): all 46 commands the branch's change set derives were run again at `5cb1c475`, 46 of 46 exit 0 (`--ran`: 46 run, 0 not measured), the line ratchet prints the same counts and ceilings as below, its self-test passes 164 cases, and the overlap check before that push reads clean against `origin/main` at `986a0f20` and PRs #35671 (shares `seat-lifecycle.md`) and #35610 (shares `SKILL.md`). The three rewritten lines measure 120, 108 and 119 bytes.
